name: Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom
description:
Who can handle the wild, untamed power of the Astral Express!? Pom-Pom, now beyond control, has transformed into Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom.
King Pom-Pom is a powerful mechatron obsessed with cleanliness and order. By its standards, this place is a mess and needs a thorough! Deep! Clean!

skills.name: Soulmend Shears
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: High-Temp Sterilization Mode
skills.description: Enters the "Steam Wash" state, increasing DMG dealt by this unit, granting this unit the "Lasting Antibac" effect, whereby its Toughness cannot be reduced, and all DMG received by this unit are greatly reduced. The efficiency of Follow-Up ATK DMG or Elation DMG dispelling "Lasting Antibac" greatly increases. When "Lasting Antibac" is dispelled, this unit exits the "Steam Wash" state, enters the Weakness Broken state, and receives massive DMG.

skills.name: Zero-Blind-Spot Cleanse
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets and grants the target team <u>Punchline</u>.

skills.name: Potent Foam Soap
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets and applies the "Work Is Bliss!" effect, while causing the target team to gain <u>Punchline</u>.

skills.name: Duty Prep in Progress...
skills.description: Enters the "Raring to Go" state and gains the "Toughness Protection" effect. Uses "Saturation Cleaning!" in the next action.

skills.name: Saturation Cleaning!
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets and grants the target team <u>Punchline</u>.

skills.name: Scrubber's Mutiny
skills.description: When battle begins, summons an "Alloy Pommy" for the target team. Each time targets gain 1 Punchline, the target team's "Alloy Pommy" accumulates 1 Charge. Upon reaching <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Charge, it can use an Enhanced Basic ATK. The target team's "Alloy Pommy" cannot be targeted by either side.

skills.name: Lasting Antibac
skills.description: If HP drops to a certain value before using "High-Temp Sterilization Mode," immediately uses "High-Temp Sterilization Mode".
